title: Cloud marketplace SKU & entitlement mapping, localized assets, and release notes sync
creator: Nina Patel
description: Objective: Prepare cross-cloud SKU and entitlement mappings, localized marketing assets, and synchronized release notes for AWS, Azure, and GCP marketplace updates. Background: Each cloud store requires unique SKU/plan identifiers, entitlement metadata, localized tile images, and vendor-specific release notes. Historically we've had mismatches between billing SKUs and product documentation which caused delayed approvals and billing reconciliation issues. Scope: - Produce canonical SKU <-> entitlement mapping CSV per cloud - Localize tile imagery and short/long descriptions for en-US, en-GB, de-DE, fr-FR, ja-JP - Create per-cloud release-notes payloads and submit through vendor portals - Validate billing reconciliation and entitlement assignment in test environments Out-of-scope: price model changes, new SKUs creation beyond mapping existing offers, legal contract negotiation Deliverables: canonical mapping CSV, localized asset package (images + text), release notes payloads for each cloud, submission checklist and post-launch verification runbook.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical SKU-to-entitlement CSV uploaded to Drive and validated by Billing and Legal (sign-off recorded)
All required localized tile images and short/long descriptions are produced and uploaded to the assets bucket (sizes and alt text per cloud guidelines)
Release notes files for AWS/Azure/GCP populated with identical customer-facing messaging and cloud-specific callouts, posted to vendor consoles or scheduled for publish
Test purchase flows validated in sandbox environments (AWS Sandbox, Azure Test Marketplace, GCP subscription test) and entitlement granted correctly
Post-launch checklist completed within 48 hours and no critical customer-facing regressions observed
